title: Blood Over Bright Haven
author: M.L. Wang
summary: In a gleaming city powered by spells cast in a great tower, a woman becomes the first of her sex admitted among its scholars. Her dream begins to clash with what keeps the city running.
readIf: you like a standalone fantasy that is angry about power and who gets to hold it.
skipIf: you want a cosy or escapist fantasy, since this one is grim and bitter in tone.

pairings.reason: Another fantasy about scholars, privilege and the hidden cost behind a shining institution.
A thoughtful story about the ideals of a society and what they ask of the people living inside it.
A larger, harsher fantasy about a world that depends on those it oppresses.
